pregunta_en: What are the names of the all-female dorms?
sql: SELECT dorm_name FROM Dorm WHERE gender = 'F'

pregunta_en: What are the first names of all students who are older than 20?
sql: SELECT fname FROM Student WHERE age > 20

pregunta_en: What is the first name of the students who are in age 20 to 25 and living in PHL city?
sql: SELECT fname FROM Student WHERE city_code = 'PHL' AND age BETWEEN 20 AND 25

pregunta_en: How many diffrent dorm amenities are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Dorm_amenity

pregunta_en: How many students are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Student

pregunta_en: Find the number of dorms that have some amenity.
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dormid) FROM Has_amenity

pregunta_en: Find the number of distinct gender for dorms.
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT gender) FROM Dorm

pregunta_en: Find the capacity and gender type of the dorm whose name has substring ‘Donor’.
sql: SELECT student_capacity, gender FROM Dorm WHERE dorm_name LIKE '%Donor%'

pregunta_en: How many different majors are there and how many different city codes are there for each student?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT major), COUNT(DISTINCT city_code) FROM Student

pregunta_en: Find the name of dorms which have both TV Lounge and Study Room as amenities.
sql: SELECT T1.dorm_name FROM Dorm AS T1 JOIN Has_amenity AS T2 ON T1.dormid = T2.dormid JOIN Dorm_amenity AS T3 ON T2.amenid = T3.amenid WHERE T3.amenity_name = 'TV Lounge' INTERSECT SELECT T1.dorm_name FROM Dorm AS T1 JOIN Has_amenity AS T2 ON T1.dormid = T2.dormid JOIN Dorm_amenity AS T3 ON T2.amenid = T3.amenid WHERE T3.amenity_name = 'Study Room'

pregunta_en: What is the name of the dorm with both a TV Lounge and Study Room listed as amenities?
sql: SELECT T1.dorm_name FROM Dorm AS T1 JOIN Has_amenity AS T2 ON T1.dormid = T2.dormid JOIN Dorm_amenity AS T3 ON T2.amenid = T3.amenid WHERE T3.amenity_name = 'TV Lounge' INTERSECT SELECT T1.dorm_name FROM Dorm AS T1 JOIN Has_amenity AS T2 ON T1.dormid = T2.dormid JOIN Dorm_amenity AS T3 ON T2.amenid = T3.amenid WHERE T3.amenity_name = 'Study Room'

pregunta_en: Find the name of dorms which have TV Lounge but no Study Room as amenity.
sql: SELECT T1.dorm_name FROM Dorm AS T1 JOIN Has_amenity AS T2 ON T1.dormid = T2.dormid JOIN Dorm_amenity AS T3 ON T2.amenid = T3.amenid WHERE T3.amenity_name = 'TV Lounge' EXCEPT SELECT T1.dorm_name FROM Dorm AS T1 JOIN Has_amenity AS T2 ON T1.dormid = T2.dormid JOIN Dorm_amenity AS T3 ON T2.amenid = T3.amenid WHERE T3.amenity_name = 'Study Room'

pregunta_en: What is the name of each dorm that has a TV Lounge but no study rooms?
sql: SELECT T1.dorm_name FROM Dorm AS T1 JOIN Has_amenity AS T2 ON T1.dormid = T2.dormid JOIN Dorm_amenity AS T3 ON T2.amenid = T3.amenid WHERE T3.amenity_name = 'TV Lounge' EXCEPT SELECT T1.dorm_name FROM Dorm AS T1 JOIN Has_amenity AS T2 ON T1.dormid = T2.dormid JOIN Dorm_amenity AS T3 ON T2.amenid = T3.amenid WHERE T3.amenity_name = 'Study Room'

pregunta_en: Find the last name of students who is either female (sex is F) and living in the city of code BAL or male (sex is M) and in age of below 20.
sql: SELECT lname FROM Student WHERE sex = 'F' AND city_code = 'BAL' UNION SELECT lname FROM Student WHERE sex = 'M' AND age < 20

pregunta_en: Find the name of the dorm with the largest capacity.
sql: SELECT dorm_name FROM Dorm ORDER BY student_capacity DESC LIMIT 1

pregunta_en: Find the first and last name of students whose age is younger than the average age.
sql: SELECT fname, lname FROM Student WHERE age < (SELECT AVG(age) FROM Student)

pregunta_en: What is the first and last name of all students who are younger than average?
sql: SELECT fname, lname FROM Student WHERE age < (SELECT AVG(age) FROM Student)

pregunta_en: What is the average age and how many male students are there in each city?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*), AVG(age), city_code FROM Student WHERE sex = 'M' GROUP BY city_code

pregunta_en: How many students are from each city, and which cities have more than one cities?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*), city_code FROM Student GROUP BY city_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

pregunta_en: Find the first and last name of students who are not in the largest major.
sql: SELECT fname, lname FROM Student WHERE major <> (SELECT major FROM Student GROUP BY major ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

pregunta_en: What is the first and last name of the students who are not in the largest major?
sql: SELECT fname, lname FROM Student WHERE major <> (SELECT major FROM Student GROUP BY major ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

pregunta_en: Find the number of students whose age is older than the average age for each gender.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*), sex FROM Student WHERE age > (SELECT AVG(age) FROM Student) GROUP BY sex

pregunta_en: How many students are older than average for each gender?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*), sex FROM Student WHERE age > (SELECT AVG(age) FROM Student) GROUP BY sex

pregunta_en: Find the average age of students living in each dorm and the name of dorm.
sql: SELECT AVG(T1.age), T3.dorm_name FROM Student AS T1 JOIN Lives_in AS T2 ON T1.stuid = T2.stuid JOIN Dorm AS T3 ON T3.dormid = T2.dormid GROUP BY T3.dorm_name

pregunta_en: Find the number of amenities for each of the dorms that can accommodate more than 100 students.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*), T1.dormid FROM Dorm AS T1 JOIN Has_amenity AS T2 ON T1.dormid = T2.dormid WHERE T1.student_capacity > 100 GROUP BY T1.dormid

pregunta_en: Find the number of students who is older than 20 in each dorm.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*), T3.dorm_name FROM Student AS T1 JOIN Lives_in AS T2 ON T1.stuid = T2.stuid JOIN Dorm AS T3 ON T3.dormid = T2.dormid WHERE T1.age > 20 GROUP BY T3.dorm_name

pregunta_en: How many students are older than 20 in each dorm?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*), T3.dorm_name FROM Student AS T1 JOIN Lives_in AS T2 ON T1.stuid = T2.stuid JOIN Dorm AS T3 ON T3.dormid = T2.dormid WHERE T1.age > 20 GROUP BY T3.dorm_name

pregunta_en: Find the average age of students who are living in the dorm with the largest capacity.
sql: SELECT AVG(T1.age) FROM Student AS T1 JOIN Lives_in AS T2 ON T1.stuid = T2.stuid JOIN Dorm AS T3 ON T3.dormid = T2.dormid WHERE T3.student_capacity = (SELECT MAX(student_capacity) FROM Dorm)

pregunta_en: What is the average age of students who are living in the dorm with the largest capacity?
sql: SELECT AVG(T1.age) FROM Student AS T1 JOIN Lives_in AS T2 ON T1.stuid = T2.stuid JOIN Dorm AS T3 ON T3.dormid = T2.dormid WHERE T3.student_capacity = (SELECT MAX(student_capacity) FROM Dorm)

pregunta_en: Find the name of dorms that do not have amenity TV Lounge.
sql: SELECT dorm_name FROM Dorm EXCEPT SELECT T1.dorm_name FROM Dorm AS T1 JOIN Has_amenity AS T2 ON T1.dormid = T2.dormid JOIN Dorm_amenity AS T3 ON T2.amenid = T3.amenid WHERE T3.amenity_name = 'TV Lounge'

pregunta_en: What are the first and last names of all students who are living in a dorm with a TV Lounge?
sql: SELECT T1.fname, T1.lname FROM Student AS T1 JOIN Lives_in AS T2 ON T1.stuid = T2.stuid WHERE T2.dormid IN (SELECT T3.dormid FROM Has_amenity AS T3 JOIN Dorm_amenity AS T4 ON T3.amenid = T4.amenid WHERE T4.amenity_name = 'TV Lounge')

pregunta_en: Find the first name and age of students who are living in the dorms that do not have amenity TV Lounge.
sql: SELECT T1.fname, T1.age FROM Student AS T1 JOIN Lives_in AS T2 ON T1.stuid = T2.stuid WHERE NOT T2.dormid IN (SELECT T3.dormid FROM Has_amenity AS T3 JOIN Dorm_amenity AS T4 ON T3.amenid = T4.amenid WHERE T4.amenity_name = 'TV Lounge')

pregunta_en: What is the first name and age of every student who lives in a dorm with a TV Lounge?
sql: SELECT T1.fname, T1.age FROM Student AS T1 JOIN Lives_in AS T2 ON T1.stuid = T2.stuid WHERE NOT T2.dormid IN (SELECT T3.dormid FROM Has_amenity AS T3 JOIN Dorm_amenity AS T4 ON T3.amenid = T4.amenid WHERE T4.amenity_name = 'TV Lounge')

pregunta_en: Find the name of amenities of the dorm where the student with last name Smith is living in.
sql: SELECT T3.amenity_name FROM Dorm AS T1 JOIN Has_amenity AS T2 ON T1.dormid = T2.dormid JOIN Dorm_amenity AS T3 ON T2.amenid = T3.amenid JOIN Lives_in AS T4 ON T4.dormid = T1.dormid JOIN Student AS T5 ON T5.stuid = T4.stuid WHERE T5.lname = 'Smith'

pregunta_en: What are the amenities in the dorm that a student who has the last name of Smith lives in?
sql: SELECT T3.amenity_name FROM Dorm AS T1 JOIN Has_amenity AS T2 ON T1.dormid = T2.dormid JOIN Dorm_amenity AS T3 ON T2.amenid = T3.amenid JOIN Lives_in AS T4 ON T4.dormid = T1.dormid JOIN Student AS T5 ON T5.stuid = T4.stuid WHERE T5.lname = 'Smith'

pregunta_en: List the name of all products along with the number of complaints that they have received.
sql: SELECT t1.product_name, COUNT(*) FROM Products AS t1 JOIN Complaints AS t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id GROUP BY t1.product_name

pregunta_en: Find the emails of customers who has filed a complaints of the product with the most complaints.
sql: SELECT t1.email_address FROM Customers AS t1 JOIN Complaints AS t2 ON t1.customer_id = t2.customer_id GROUP BY t1.customer_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) LIMIT 1

pregunta_en: Return the phone number of the customer who filed the complaint that was raised most recently.
sql: SELECT t1.phone_number FROM Customers AS t1 JOIN Complaints AS t2 ON t1.customer_id = t2.customer_id ORDER BY t2.date_complaint_raised DESC LIMIT 1

pregunta_en: Find the email and phone number of the customers who have never filed a complaint before.
sql: SELECT email_address, phone_number FROM Customers WHERE NOT customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM Complaints)

pregunta_en: What are the emails and phone numbers of custoemrs who have never filed a complaint?
sql: SELECT email_address, phone_number FROM Customers WHERE NOT customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM Complaints)

pregunta_en: What are the phone numbers of all customers and all staff members?
sql: SELECT phone_number FROM Customers UNION SELECT phone_number FROM Staff

pregunta_en: Return the description of the product called "Chocolate".
sql: SELECT product_description FROM Products WHERE product_name = 'Chocolate'

pregunta_en: Which complaint status has more than 3 records on file?
sql: SELECT complaint_status_code FROM Complaints GROUP BY complaint_status_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

pregunta_en: Count the number of customers that have the customer type that is most common.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customers GROUP BY customer_type_code ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

pregunta_en: Find the address line 1 and 2 of the customer with email "vbogisich@example.org".
sql: SELECT address_line_1, address_line_2 FROM Customers WHERE email_address = 'vbogisich@example.org'

pregunta_en: How many submissions are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submission

pregunta_en: For each submission, find its author and acceptance result.
sql: SELECT T2.Author, T1.Result FROM Acceptance AS T1 JOIN submission AS T2 ON T1.Submission_ID = T2.Submission_ID

pregunta_en: Which submission received the highest score in acceptance result. Show me the result.
sql: SELECT T1.Result FROM Acceptance AS T1 JOIN submission AS T2 ON T1.Submission_ID = T2.Submission_ID ORDER BY T2.Scores DESC LIMIT 1

pregunta_en: List the authors who do not have submission to any workshop.
sql: SELECT Author FROM submission WHERE NOT Submission_ID IN (SELECT Submission_ID FROM Acceptance)

pregunta_en: Which authors did not submit to any workshop?
sql: SELECT Author FROM submission WHERE NOT Submission_ID IN (SELECT Submission_ID FROM Acceptance)

pregunta_en: Show all investor details.
sql: SELECT Investor_details FROM Investors

pregunta_en: Show the minimum amount of transactions whose type code is "PUR" and whose share count is bigger than 50.
sql: SELECT MIN(amount_of_transaction) FROM Transactions WHERE transaction_type_code = 'PUR' AND share_count > 50

pregunta_en: What are the purchase details of transactions with amount bigger than 10000?
sql: SELECT T1.purchase_details FROM Purchases AS T1 JOIN Transactions AS T2 ON T1.purchase_transaction_id = T2.transaction_id WHERE T2.amount_of_transaction > 10000

pregunta_en: Show the average transaction amount for different transaction types.
sql: SELECT transaction_type_code, AVG(amount_of_transaction) FROM Transactions GROUP BY transaction_type_code

pregunta_en: Show the maximum and minimum share count of different transaction types.
sql: SELECT transaction_type_code, MAX(share_count), MIN(share_count) FROM Transactions GROUP BY transaction_type_code

pregunta_en: Show the average share count of transactions for different investors.
sql: SELECT investor_id, AVG(share_count) FROM Transactions GROUP BY investor_id

pregunta_en: Show the average amount of transactions for different lots.
sql: SELECT T2.lot_id, AVG(amount_of_transaction) FROM Transactions AS T1 JOIN Transactions_Lots AS T2 ON T1.transaction_id = T2.transaction_id GROUP BY T2.lot_id

pregunta_en: Show the id and details of the investor that has the largest number of transactions.
sql: SELECT T2.investor_id, T1.Investor_details FROM Investors AS T1 JOIN Transactions AS T2 ON T1.investor_id = T2.investor_id GROUP BY T2.investor_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

pregunta_en: Show the ids of the investors who have at least two transactions.
sql: SELECT T2.investor_id FROM Investors AS T1 JOIN Transactions AS T2 ON T1.investor_id = T2.investor_id GROUP BY T2.investor_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

pregunta_en: What are the details of all sales and purchases?
sql: SELECT sales_details FROM Sales UNION SELECT purchase_details FROM Purchases

pregunta_en: What are the details of the lots which are not used in any transactions?
sql: SELECT lot_details FROM Lots EXCEPT SELECT T1.lot_details FROM Lots AS T1 JOIN Transactions_Lots AS T2 ON T1.lot_id = T2.lot_id

pregunta_en: How many available hotels are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Hotels

pregunta_en: What is the address of the location "UK Gallery"?
sql: SELECT Address FROM Locations WHERE Location_Name = 'UK Gallery'

pregunta_en: Find the names and opening hours of the tourist attractions that we get to by bus or walk.
sql: SELECT Name, Opening_Hours FROM Tourist_Attractions WHERE How_to_Get_There = 'bus' OR How_to_Get_There = 'walk'

pregunta_en: What are the names and descriptions of the photos taken at the tourist attraction "film festival"?
sql: SELECT T1.Name, T1.Description FROM Photos AS T1 JOIN Tourist_Attractions AS T2 ON T1.Tourist_Attraction_ID = T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID WHERE T2.Name = 'film festival'

pregunta_en: What are the details and ways to get to tourist attractions related to royal family?
sql: SELECT T1.Royal_Family_Details, T2.How_to_Get_There FROM Royal_Family AS T1 JOIN Tourist_Attractions AS T2 ON T1.Royal_Family_ID = T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID

pregunta_en: Find the details of all the markets that are accessible by walk or bus.
sql: SELECT T1.Market_Details FROM Street_Markets AS T1 JOIN Tourist_Attractions AS T2 ON T1.Market_ID = T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID WHERE T2.How_to_Get_There = 'walk' OR T2.How_to_Get_There = 'bus'

pregunta_en: What are the visit date and details of the visitor whose detail is 'Vincent'?
sql: SELECT T2.Visit_Date, T2.Visit_Details FROM Visitors AS T1 JOIN Visits AS T2 ON T1.Tourist_ID = T2.Tourist_ID WHERE T1.Tourist_Details = 'Vincent'

pregunta_en: What are the average prices of hotels grouped by their pet policy.
sql: SELECT pets_allowed_yn, AVG(price_range) FROM Hotels GROUP BY pets_allowed_yn

pregunta_en: Show the details of the top 3 most expensive hotels.
sql: SELECT other_hotel_details FROM Hotels ORDER BY price_range DESC LIMIT 3

pregunta_en: What are the details of the three most expensive hotels?
sql: SELECT other_hotel_details FROM Hotels ORDER BY price_range DESC LIMIT 3

pregunta_en: Show the transportation method most people choose to get to tourist attractions.
sql: SELECT How_to_Get_There FROM Tourist_Attractions GROUP BY How_to_Get_There ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

pregunta_en: List all the possible ways to get to attractions, together with the number of attractions accessible by these methods.
sql: SELECT How_to_Get_There, COUNT(*) FROM Tourist_Attractions GROUP BY How_to_Get_There

pregunta_en: Show different tourist attractions' names, ids, and the corresponding number of visits.
sql: SELECT T1.Name, T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID, COUNT(*) FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Visits AS T2 ON T1.Tourist_Attraction_ID = T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID GROUP BY T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID

pregunta_en: Which tourist attractions are visited at least twice? Give me their names and ids.
sql: SELECT T1.Name, T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Visits AS T2 ON T1.Tourist_Attraction_ID = T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID GROUP BY T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

pregunta_en: What are the names of the tourist attractions that have parking or shopping as their feature details?
sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Tourist_Attraction_Features AS T2 ON T1.tourist_attraction_id = T2.tourist_attraction_id JOIN Features AS T3 ON T2.Feature_ID = T3.Feature_ID WHERE T3.feature_Details = 'park' UNION SELECT T1.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Tourist_Attraction_Features AS T2 ON T1.tourist_attraction_id = T2.tourist_attraction_id JOIN Features AS T3 ON T2.Feature_ID = T3.Feature_ID WHERE T3.feature_Details = 'shopping'

pregunta_en: What are the names of the tourist attractions Vincent and Marcelle visit?
sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Visitors AS T2 ON TRUE JOIN Visits AS T3 ON T1.Tourist_Attraction_ID = T3.Tourist_Attraction_ID AND T2.Tourist_ID = T3.Tourist_ID WHERE T2.Tourist_Details = 'Vincent' INTERSECT SELECT T1.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Visitors AS T2 ON TRUE JOIN Visits AS T3 ON T1.Tourist_Attraction_ID = T3.Tourist_Attraction_ID AND T2.Tourist_ID = T3.Tourist_ID WHERE T2.Tourist_Details = 'Marcelle'

pregunta_en: What are the names of tourist attraction that Alison visited but Rosalind did not visit?
sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Visitors AS T2 ON TRUE JOIN Visits AS T3 ON T1.Tourist_Attraction_ID = T3.Tourist_Attraction_ID AND T2.Tourist_ID = T3.Tourist_ID WHERE T2.Tourist_Details = 'Alison' EXCEPT SELECT T1.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Visitors AS T2 ON TRUE JOIN Visits AS T3 ON T1.Tourist_Attraction_ID = T3.Tourist_Attraction_ID AND T2.Tourist_ID = T3.Tourist_ID WHERE T2.Tourist_Details = 'Rosalind'

pregunta_en: Find the the names of the tourist attractions that the tourist named Alison visited but Rosalind did not visit.
sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Visitors AS T2 ON TRUE JOIN Visits AS T3 ON T1.Tourist_Attraction_ID = T3.Tourist_Attraction_ID AND T2.Tourist_ID = T3.Tourist_ID WHERE T2.Tourist_Details = 'Alison' EXCEPT SELECT T1.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Visitors AS T2 ON TRUE JOIN Visits AS T3 ON T1.Tourist_Attraction_ID = T3.Tourist_Attraction_ID AND T2.Tourist_ID = T3.Tourist_ID WHERE T2.Tourist_Details = 'Rosalind'

pregunta_en: How many tourists did not make any visit?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Visitors WHERE NOT Tourist_ID IN (SELECT Tourist_ID FROM Visits)

pregunta_en: What is the type of video game Call of Destiny.
sql: SELECT gtype FROM Video_Games WHERE gname = 'Call of Destiny'

pregunta_en: Show all video game types and the number of video games in each type.
sql: SELECT gtype, COUNT(*) FROM Video_Games GROUP BY gtype

pregunta_en: What are the types of video games and how many are in each type?
sql: SELECT gtype, COUNT(*) FROM Video_Games GROUP BY gtype

pregunta_en: Which game type has least number of games?
sql: SELECT gtype FROM Video_Games GROUP BY gtype ORDER BY COUNT(*) LIMIT 1

pregunta_en: Show ids for all students who live in CHI.
sql: SELECT StuID FROM Student WHERE city_code = 'CHI'

pregunta_en: What are the ids of all students who have advisor number 1121?
sql: SELECT StuID FROM Student WHERE Advisor = 1121

pregunta_en: What are the advisors
sql: SELECT advisor FROM Student GROUP BY advisor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

pregunta_en: How many sports do we have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sportname) FROM SportsInfo

pregunta_en: How many different students are involved in sports?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT StuID) FROM SportsInfo

pregunta_en: What are the last names for all scholarship students?

pregunta_en: How many games are played for all students?
sql: SELECT SUM(gamesplayed) FROM SportsInfo

pregunta_en: How many students play each sport?
sql: SELECT sportname, COUNT(*) FROM SportsInfo GROUP BY sportname

pregunta_en: What are the ids of all students along with how many sports and games did they play?

pregunta_en: Show student ids who don't have any sports.

pregunta_en: What are the ids of all students who don't play sports?

pregunta_en: Show student ids who are on scholarship and have major 600.
sql: SELECT StuID FROM Student WHERE major = 600 INTERSECT SELECT StuID FROM SportsInfo WHERE onscholarship = 'Y'

pregunta_en: What are the student ids for those on scholarship in major number 600?
sql: SELECT StuID FROM Student WHERE major = 600 INTERSECT SELECT StuID FROM SportsInfo WHERE onscholarship = 'Y'

sql: SELECT StuID FROM Student WHERE sex = 'F' INTERSECT SELECT StuID FROM SportsInfo WHERE sportname = 'Football'

pregunta_en: What are the ids of all female students who play football?
sql: SELECT StuID FROM Student WHERE sex = 'F' INTERSECT SELECT StuID FROM SportsInfo WHERE sportname = 'Football'

pregunta_en: What are the ids of all male students who do not play football?
sql: SELECT StuID FROM Student WHERE sex = 'M' EXCEPT SELECT StuID FROM SportsInfo WHERE sportname = 'Football'
